title: Luhn Card Validator
description: Takes a card or identifier number (spaces and dashes ignored) and returns whether it passes the Luhn mod-10 checksum, the actual and expected check digit, the detected card brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, Discover, JCB, UnionPay, Maestro) and whether the length fits that brand. Invalid input returns valid:false with error and message.
